# Reading in Dataset


# Data Cleaning
```{r}
colSums(is.na(arrest)) # Noticed 10 missing values in KY_CD

arrest <- arrest %>% drop_na(KY_CD) # Dropped the rows
```
# Removing Duplicates
```{r}
nrow(arrest) - nrow(distinct(arrest))
```

# Converting to appropriate data types
```{r}
arrest <- arrest %>%
  mutate(
    ARREST_DATE = mdy(ARREST_DATE),
    
    LAW_CAT_CD = case_when(
      LAW_CAT_CD %in% c("F","FELONY") ~ "Felony",
      LAW_CAT_CD %in% c("M","MISDEMEANOR") ~ "Misdemeanor",
      LAW_CAT_CD %in% c("V","VIOLATION") ~ "Violation",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Felony","Misdemeanor","Violation")),

    AGE_GROUP = AGE_GROUP %>%
      fct_recode(
        "<18" = "<18", "18-24" = "18-24", "25-44" = "25-44",
        "45-64" = "45-64", "65+" = "65+"
      ) %>%
      fct_relevel("<18","18-24","25-44","45-64","65+"),

    PERP_SEX  = factor(PERP_SEX, levels = c("M","F","U")),
    PERP_RACE = factor(PERP_RACE),
    
    LAW_CAT_CD = fct_na_value_to_level(LAW_CAT_CD, level = "Other Authority"),

    ARREST_BORO = recode(ARREST_BORO,
                         B = "BRONX", K = "BROOKLYN", M = "MANHATTAN",
                         Q = "QUEENS", S = "STATEN ISLAND", .default = NA_character_) %>%
                  factor(levels = c("MANHATTAN","BRONX","BROOKLYN","QUEENS","STATEN ISLAND")),

    Latitude  = ifelse(is.na(Latitude)  | Latitude  == 0, NA_real_, Latitude),
    Longitude = ifelse(is.na(Longitude) | Longitude == 0, NA_real_, Longitude),

    Latitude  = ifelse(Latitude  < 40 | Latitude  > 42, NA_real_, Latitude),
    Longitude = ifelse(Longitude > -71 | Longitude < -75, NA_real_, Longitude)
  )
```

```{r}
arrest <- arrest %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(ARREST_DATE, "month"),
         dow = wday(ARREST_DATE, label = TRUE))

ggplot(arrest, aes(month)) +
  geom_bar(fill="orange") +
  labs(title = "Arrests per Month", x = NULL, y = "Count") +

  geom_bar(position = "fill") +

  labs(title = "Monthly Arrest Mix (Felony/Misd/Violation)", x = NULL, y = "Proportion", fill = "Law") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(arrest, aes(dow)) +
  geom_bar(fill="blue") +
  labs(title = "Arrests by Day of Week", x = NULL, y = "Count") +
```


```{r}
violent <- c("ROBBERY", "FELONY ASSAULT", "ASSAULT 3 & RELATED OFFENSES",
             "RAPE", "SEX arrestS", "DANGEROUS WEAPONS", "OFFENSES AGAINST THE PERSON",
             "MURDER & NON-NEGL. MANSLAUGHTE", "HARRASSMENT 2",

             "HOMICIDE-NEGLIGENT-VEHICLE", "UNLAWFUL POSS. WEAP. ON SCHOOL")

property <- c("PETIT LARCENY", "CRIMINAL TRESPASS", "BURGLARY",
              "GRAND LARCENY", "ARSON", "OTHER OFFENSES RELATED TO THEFT",
              "CRIMINAL MISCHIEF & RELATED OF", "POSSESSION OF STOLEN PROPERTY",
              "GRAND LARCENY OF MOTOR VEHICLE", "BURGLAR'S TOOLS", "UNAUTHORIZED USE OF A VEHICLE",
              "JOSTLING")

morality <- c("DANGEROUS DRUGS", "PROSTITUTION & RELATED OFFENSES",
              "ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE CONTROL LAW", "CANNABIS RELATED OFFENSES",
              "GAMBLING", "LOITERING/GAMBLING (CARDS, DIC)",
              "DISORDERLY CONDUCT", "DISRUPTION OF A RELIGIOUS SERV", "CHILD ABANDONMENT/NON SUPPORT 1", "OFFENSES RELATED TO CHILDREN")

traffic <- c("MOVING INFRACTIONS", "VEHICLE AND TRAFFIC LAWS",
             "OTHER TRAFFIC INFRACTION", "INTOXICATED & IMPAIRED DRIVING",
             "INTOXICATED/IMPAIRED DRIVING")

white_collar <- c("FORGERY", "FRAUDS", "FRAUDULENT ACCOSTING",
                  "THEFT-FRAUD", "OFFENSES INVOLVING FRAUD")

arrest$CRIME_TYPE <- case_when(
  arrest$OFNS_DESC %in% violent ~ "violent",
  arrest$OFNS_DESC %in% property ~ "property",
  arrest$OFNS_DESC %in% morality ~ "morality",
  arrest$OFNS_DESC %in% traffic ~ "traffic",
  arrest$OFNS_DESC %in% white_collar ~ "white-collar",
  TRUE ~ "other"   
)

arrest$CRIME_TYPE <- factor(arrest$CRIME_TYPE,
                            levels = c("violent", "property", 
                                       "morality", "traffic", 
                                       "white-collar", "other"))
```

#Multiple Correspondence Analysis
```{r}
res.mca <- MCA(X_cat, graph = FALSE) #MCA
fviz_screeplot(res.mca, addlabels = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 20)) #Produce screeplot
```







```{r}
# Compute robust estimates of mean and covariance using Minimum Covariance Determinant (MCD)
mcd <- covMcd(coords)

# Calculate robust Mahalanobis distances for each observation
mahal_robust <- mahalanobis(coords, mcd$center, mcd$cov)

# Define the 99th percentile as the cutoff threshold for outliers
cutoff <- quantile(mahal_robust, 0.99)

# Flag points whose robust Mahalanobis distance exceeds the cutoff
outlier_flag <- mahal_robust > cutoff

# Plot MCA coordinates
plot(coords[,1], coords[,2],
     col = ifelse(outlier_flag, "red", "black"),  # red = outlier, black = inlier
     pch = ifelse(outlier_flag, 19, 1),           # filled circle for outliers
     main = "Outlier Detection (Robust Mahalanobis)",
     xlab = "MCA Dim 1", ylab = "MCA Dim 2")

# Add legend to indicate which points are inliers/outliers
legend("topright", legend=c("Inliers", "Outliers"), col=c("black","red"), pch=c(1,19))

# Remove detected outliers from both coordinate matrix and original data
coords_clean <- coords[!outlier_flag, ]
data_clean <- arrest_sample[!outlier_flag, ]

# Use silhouette method to determine optimal number of clusters
fviz_nbclust(coords_clean, FUN = hcut, method = "silhouette")

```


```{r}
#Plot dendogram based on smaller sample
set.seed(123)
sub_idx <- sample(1:nrow(umap_coords), 100) 
hc_sub <- hclust(dist(umap_coords[sub_idx, ]), method = "ward.D2")
fviz_dend(hc_sub, k = 6, cex = 0.8, rect = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Apply UMAP for nonlinear dimensionality reduction on cleaned coordinates
umap_coords <- umap(coords_clean)$layout

# Perform hierarchical clustering using Ward
hc <- hclust(dist(umap_coords), method = "ward.D2")

# Cut the dendrogram into 6 clusters (k = 6)
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = 6)

# Assign cluster labels to the cleaned dataset
data_clean$Cluster <- as.factor(clusters)

# Visualize clusters on the MCA coordinate space
fviz_cluster(list(data = coords_clean, cluster = data_clean$Cluster),
             geom = "point",          # display points
             ellipse.type = "convex", # draw convex hulls around clusters
             main = "Hierarchical Clusters on MCA space")

```


```{r}
# Define categorical variables to summarise across clusters
vars <- c("ARREST_BORO", "CRIME_TYPE", "PERP_RACE", "AGE_GROUP", "PERP_SEX")

out_list <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  # Convert counts to row percentages
  tab <- prop.table(table(data_clean$Cluster, data_clean[[v]]), 1) * 100
  tab_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(round(tab, 1))
  
  # Add Cluster columns to make it easier to read/print
  tab_df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(tab_df, "Cluster")
  
  # Label clusters
  tab_df <- tab_df %>%
    mutate(Cluster = paste("Cluster", Cluster))
  
  # Return list with variable name and formatted table
  list(name = v, data = tab_df)
})

# Print all summary tables
for (i in seq_along(out_list)) {
  print(
    kable(out_list[[i]]$data, 
          caption = paste(out_list[[i]]$name, "by Cluster (%)")) %>% 
      kable_styling(full_width = TRUE, position = "center")
  )
  cat("\n\n")  # Add spacing
}

```
```{r}
# Fit a multinomial logistic regression model using VGAM
fit_mnl <- vgam(
  CRIME_TYPE ~ ARREST_BORO + AGE_GROUP + PERP_SEX + PERP_RACE,
  family = multinomial(refLevel = "violent"),  # "violent" as baseline class
  data = arrest                               
)


```

```{r}
saveRDS(fit_mnl, file = "fit_mnl.rds")   # multinomial vgam model
saveRDS(arrest,  file = "arrest.rds")    # training data frame
```
